card.title: Choose the Relationship
card.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay home from the networking dinner. I've finally learned your mother's dumplings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director's coming. I could get promoted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then staying would tell me I'm more than the person keeping dinner warm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Freeze them. We'll have them tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what you said on our anniversary. Call and say you've already got dinner with me.

mechanism: A asks B to choose their shared evening over a career opportunity after a prior meaningful meal was postponed.
confusable: Unlike a generic invitation, A must demand that the connection outrank the competing opportunity now.
comparison: D82-b asks for a cancellation naming the existing dinner; D82-a asks for wedding promises to occupy protected calendar time.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
